entities.title: zazzle-git
entities.summary: `zazzle git`: a small git front end with a modeless terminal editor made for commit messages, pull request bodies, changelog entries and rebase todo lists, and a commit flow that keeps a draft message and lets the developer choose the files. One Rust package, three binaries.
entities.purpose: The crate of the zazzle-git, zazzle-git-commit and zazzle-git-commit-message-editor binaries: Cargo.toml, the user README, the library and binaries in src/, and the pseudo-terminal end-to-end tests in tests/. It is one member of the Cargo workspace in macos/rust.
boundaries: It uses no other crate in the repository. The zazzle invoker (macos/c/zazzle) runs it for `zazzle git ARGS` by exec'ing the zazzle-git binary beside itself; it never goes through the zazzled daemon.
Everything except help, version, `message` and `commit` is handed to the real git unchanged; the crate only runs git as a separate program.
Building, CI (including its 95% line and branch coverage gate) and publishing the binaries are the workspace's and the workflows' concern, not this folder's.

relationships.description: The invoker that execs zazzle-git for `zazzle git`.
